Xariiqda la wadaago ka hor 2015 waa taxanaha taariikhiga ah ee la arkay; hab-raac kasta wuu ka go'aa wixii ka dambeeya, sida saxda ah ee uu kaydku u daabacay — waxba halkan lagama qiyaasin labadooda dhexdooda.
Strong, sustained mitigation with net-ze: Dhimis xooggan oo joogto ah iyada oo la gaarayo eber saafi ah oo CO₂ qeybta labaad ee qarniga. Guud ahaan waa beddelka RCP2.6 waxayna si dhow ula socotaa heerka sare ee yoolalka Paris.
Development follows historical patterns;: Horumarku wuxuu raacayaa hababka taariikhiga ah; qiiqa wuxuu ku dhow yahay heerarka hadda ilaa bartamaha qarniga ka dibna wuu hoos u dhacayaa. Inta badan waxaa loo arkaa midka ugu dhow siyaasadaha qaran ee lagu dhawaaqay.
Resurgent nationalism, weak internationa: Waddaniyadda soo cusboonaatay, iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee daciifka ah iyo isbeddelka farsamada oo gaabis ah. Qiiqa wuxuu ku dhowaad labanlaabmayaa 2100. Saameyn xooggan oo ka timaada aerosol iyo isticmaalka dhulka.
Rapid, energy-intensive growth built on: Kobac degdeg ah oo tamarta aad u isticmaala kuna dhisan shidaalka fosilka ee badan. Heerka sare ee cabbirka CMIP6; hadda waxaa si ballaaran loo arkaa xad sare oo suurtogalnimadiisu yar tahay halkii laga arki lahaa xaalad caadi ah.
El Niño is a climate condition in which: El Niño waa xaalad cimilo oo qaybo ka mid ah bartamaha iyo bariga kulaylaha Badweynta Baasifigga ay noqdaan kuwo si aan caadi ahayn u kulul. Tani waxay saameyn kartaa wareegga hawada waxayna beddeli kartaa suurtogalnimada roobabka iyo qaababka heerkulka meelo badan oo adduunka ah.
La Niña is the opposite phase, when the: La Niña waa wejiga lidka ku ah, marka isla qaybta kulaylaha Baasifigga ay noqoto mid si aan caadi ahayn u qabow.
ENSO stands for El Niño Southern Oscilla: ENSO waxay u taagan tahay El Niño Southern Oscillation. Waa nidaamka guud ee cimilada oo ay ku jiraan xaaladaha El Niño, La Niña iyo Dhexdhexaad.
NOAA grades an event by its peak RONI: W: NOAA waxay ku qiimeysaa dhacdo heerka ugu sarreeya ee RONI: Daciif (0.5–0.9), Dhexdhexaad (1.0–1.4), Xooggan (1.5–1.9), iyo Super/Aad u Xooggan (2.0 °C ama ka badan) — isla heerarka boggani u isticmaalo inuu ku magacaabo akhriska hadda.
El Niño can influence the probability of: El Niño waxay saameyn kartaa suurtogalnimada roobka iyo isbeddelka heerkulka, laakiin ma go'aamiso cimilada kaligeed. Saamaynta beeraha waxay ku xiran tahay roobka dhabta ah, heerkulka, helitaanka biyaha iyo xaaladaha dalagga ee dhulka ka jira.
El Niño is an important global climate s: El Niño waa calaamad cimilo oo caalami ah oo muhiim ah. Waa sabab si dhow loola socdo — mana aha keligeed saadaal lagu go'aaminayo khasaaraha beeraha.
RONI (Relative Oceanic Niño Index) is an: RONI (Relative Oceanic Niño Index) waa tusmo loo isticmaalo in lagu qeexo xaaladaha El Niño iyo La Niña iyadoo la tixgelinayo xaaladaha heerkulka guud ahaan badweynta kulaylaha ee ballaaran.
A positive RONI indicates conditions on: RONI togan waxay tilmaamaysaa xaaladaha dhanka El Niño, halka RONI taban ay muujinayso xaaladaha dhanka La Niña. Mar kasta oo qiimuhu ka fogaado dhexdhexaadka, calaamadda cimilada Baasifigga ayaa sii xoogaysan karta.
RONI itself does not measure crop stress: RONI lafteeda ma cabbirto culayska dalagga. Waxay noo sheegaysaa xoogga wade cimilo oo baaxad weyn. Sidaas darteed waxaan u baahannahay inaan si gooni ah u baarno roobka, heerkulka, baahida biyaha, qoyaanka ciidda iyo jawaabta dhirta.
RONI waxay noo sheegaysaa wade-bixiyaha cimilada. U kuurgelidda dhulka waxay noo sheegaysaa saameynta dhabta ah.

SST means Sea Surface Temperature — simp: SST waxay u taagan tahay Heerkulka Dusha Sare ee Badda — si fudud waa heerkulka oogada badda.

Tusaale ahaan, +1.8 °C macnaheedu maaha in heerkulka baddu yahay 1.8 °C — waxay ka dhigan tahay in baddu qiyaastii 1.8 °C ka kulushahay heerkulkeeda caadiga ah ee la filayay.
This Pacific warming can influence large: Kuleylkaan Baasifigga wuxuu saameyn karaa wareegga hawada ee baaxadda weyn, kaas oo markaa ka dib saameyn kara roobabka gobolka iyo qaababka heerkulka. Strong Pacific warming can increase the: Kuleyl xooggan oo Baasifigga ah wuxuu kordhin karaa suurtogalnimada saameynta cimilada ee gobollada qaarkood, laakiin isla awoodda ENSO mar kasta ma keento xaalado beereed isku mid ah.

Continued El Niño conditions mean that c: Xaaladaha El Niño ee socda waxay ka dhigan yihiin in qaybaha u nugul cimilada sida beeraha ay tahay inay sii wadaan kormeerka roobka, heerkulka iyo helitaanka biyaha. Macnaheedu maaha in khasaaraha beeruhu yahay mid aan laga baaqsan karin.
This is an outlook for the Pacific clima: Tani waa saadaal ku saabsan nidaamka cimilada Baasifigga. Khatarta dhabta ah ee beeraha waa in lagu qiimeeyaa iyadoo la adeegsanayo indho-indheynta dhulka.
A Shared Socioeconomic Pathway — a scena: Hab-raaca Dhaqan-dhaqaale ee La Wadaago (Shared Socioeconomic Pathway) — xaalad isku xiraysa dariiqa mustaqbalka ee qiiqa gaaska aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo iyo sheekada dhaqan-dhaqaale (dadweynaha, isticmaalka tamarta, isticmaalka dhulka) ee keeni karta.
The radiative forcing reached by 2100, i: Awoodda shucaaca ee la gaaro marka la gaaro 2100, watt kasta oo mitir labajibbaaran — cabbir toos ah oo muujinaya inta tamar dheeraad ah ee hab-raacaasi qabto. SSP1-1.9 waa tan ugu hooseysa, SSP5-8.5 ugu sarreysa.
None of the four pathways shown here is: Midna afarta hab-raac ee halkan lagu muujiyay ma aha saadaal dhab ah. Waa afar xaaladood oo mustaqbal ah oo "maxaa dhacaya haddii" ah oo isku xiran, laga bilaabo dhimis caalami ah oo xooggan (SSP1-2.6) ilaa koritaanka sare ee shidaalka fosilka ee socda (SSP5-8.5), loo isticmaalo si akhristuhu u arko sida natiijada cimiladu lafteedu ugu xiran tahay go'aannada aysan bulshadu weli gaarin.
Which pathway is \"most likely\" is a po: Hab-raaca "ugu macquulsan" waa su'aal siyaasadeed, ma aha mid cilmiyeed — tirooyinkani waxay qeexayaan "haddii" kasta, ma aha waxa dhabta ah ee dhici doona.
